Learn ancient history

Every card in Shoulders of Giants is a real person, place or idea from history. Pick an era to meet the people and ideas that shaped the ancient world, then play them in the game.

  • Prehistory

    Meet Lucy, the Neanderthals and Ötzi the Iceman. Learn how early humans used tools and fire, made art, and started farming.

    Explore Prehistory · 11 cards

  • Mesopotamia

    Learn about Sumer, cuneiform, Gilgamesh, Sargon's empire and Hammurabi's Code: the first cities and laws, between the Tigris and Euphrates rivers.

    Explore Mesopotamia · 15 cards

  • Ancient Egypt

    Learn about the Nile, the pharaohs, pyramids and hieroglyphics, from Narmer uniting Egypt to Hatshepsut's trade and the Rosetta Stone.

    Explore Ancient Egypt · 23 cards
